subject: Can't log in after password reset
question: I reset my password but now it says invalid credentials when I try to log in.
resolution: This usually happens if the reset link was used more than once, or if there's a trailing space copied into the password field. We had the customer clear the field completely, retype the password manually (not paste), and it resolved the issue. If that fails, a fresh password reset link usually fixes it.

subject: Charged twice this month
question: I see two charges on my card this billing cycle for the same plan.
resolution: Escalated to billing team — duplicate charges are not resolvable by support directly and require a billing team review and manual refund if confirmed.

subject: CSV export missing rows
question: My CSV export only has 500 rows but I have way more records than that.
resolution: Confirmed this was due to an active filter left on from a previous session. Export respects active filters. Customer cleared filters and re-exported successfully, getting the full record count.

subject: How to add a team member with limited access
question: I want to add someone to my team but only let them view reports, not edit anything.
resolution: Directed customer to Team Settings > Members > Invite, and told them to select the 'Viewer' role which only allows read access to reports and dashboards, no editing permissions.

subject: API returning 429 errors
question: My integration started failing with 429 status codes today.
resolution: Checked account plan — customer was on Pro plan (1000 req/hr limit) and their integration was polling every second. Recommended batching requests or upgrading to Enterprise for higher rate limits, and added exponential backoff guidance.

subject: Want a refund for annual plan
question: I just realized I don't need this anymore, can I get a refund for my annual subscription?
resolution: Escalated to billing/account management team — refund requests outside the standard cancellation policy require manual review and approval, not something support can resolve directly.

subject: 2FA backup codes lost
question: I lost my phone and my 2FA backup codes, I can't get into my account.
resolution: Escalated to security team for identity verification before account access could be restored — this requires manual identity verification and cannot be automated for security reasons.

subject: Dashboard extremely slow with large date range
question: My dashboard takes over a minute to load when I select the last 12 months.
resolution: Explained that large date ranges query more data and recommended narrowing to 30-90 day windows for daily use, with monthly rollup reports for longer-term views. Also suggested clearing cache.
